title: Rest And Still Rise (5 Minute R&B)
style: contemporary r&b with hip-hop flow, 84-94 bpm, crisp programmed drums with tight hats, deep sub bass, Rhodes chord stabs, bright synth plucks, smooth sung r&b hook, call-and-response ad-libs, confident swagger, dry upfront vocal, radio-ready mix. Warm female lead sings the hook with sustained notes; the verses are rhythmic rap with clear diction over the beat. The lead SPEAKS the lines tagged Spoken in a plain natural voice over the music, RAPS the lines tagged Rap with confident metered flow, and SINGS the lines tagged Sung with long held notes. The intro and the outro are spoken; the full band keeps playing continuously under them, natural resolved ending, final chord rings out and fades.
negative_tags: choir, reverb, echo, band dropout, acapella sections, talk-singing, monotone delivery

kie_params.duration: delivered seconds (L-2); G9 headroom question is open decision 3 in file 18

segments.lyrics:
[Intro (spoken): Vocal A, close dry voice, plain speech, no melody]
Two in the morning, and I am running on empty.

[Vocalise (sung): Vocal A, wordless, full melodic voice, two very long held notes]
Ooh-oo-ooh, ooh-oo-ooh

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 1 (rap): Vocal A, female voice, tight rhythmic rap, conversational flow, clear diction]
Alarm at five and I'm already behind on the day,
Packed every lunch, signed every form, still had to pay,
Boss says my name in the meeting and the whole room turns,
Smile on my face while the whole inside of me burns,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Pre-Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, rhymed]
Two in the morning, sti-ill,
I cannot climb this hi-ill,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Verse 2 (rap): Vocal A, female voice, tight rhythmic rap, conversational flow, clear diction]
Two in the morning and the numbers just will not add,
Giving my all and still feeling like I'm doing bad,
Tried every planner, every hack, every early alarm,
Running on empty was doing me nothing but harm,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 3 (rap): Vocal B, male voice, low-register conversational rap, clear diction]
I watched her carry the weight like it came with the name,
Told her you're tired, not broken, and rest isn't shame,
Handed her pages that showed her the way to slow down,
Now she's the calmest one standing all over this town,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Product (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, clear diction on the name]
She handed me a bo-ook,
The Unhurried Year, look,
Each page said slow and sta-ay,
I read it every single da-ay,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Bridge (sung): Vocal A, half-time, stripped back, sustained]
I wondered, is this ri-ight?
Can rest be how I fi-ight?
I slowed my mornings dow-own,
I laid the heavy crow-own,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Product (reprise) (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, clear diction on the name]
The Unhurried Year I keep,
the night I learned to slee-eep,
It taught me how to sta-ay,
and let the rush give wa-ay,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Hook (sung): Vocal A and Vocal B, both vocalists, harmonized]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Verse 4 (sung): Vocal A, melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
My house is calm and free-ee,
my daughter smiles at me-e,
No more running on empty-y,
no more proving I am wo-orthy,

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Hook (sung): Vocal A, smooth r&b melody, sustained notes, clear diction]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Outro (spoken): Vocal A, calm close voice, plain speech, no melody]
My friend handed me The Unhurried Year by Dana Wells. Rest is not quitting. Tap the link and get the book today.

[End]
